d:
Experience the magic of 'Yoon Shabnami' from 'Saawariya' in stunning 4K! This soft romantic ballad, influenced by a mix of Sufi music and Qawwali, features Ranbir Kapoor and Sonam Kapoor. The video captures the celebration of the moon's appearance and the announcement of Eid. 'Saawariya,' an artistic Bollywood romantic drama produced and directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, showcases the soulful voice of Parthiv Gohil with music directed by Monty Sharma. Don't miss Salman Khan's special guest appearance in this beautifully remastered version!
Song Name - Yoon Shabnami
Movie - Saawariya
